Name: ECGG_3A_SWQP
Note: APA ECGG Stage 3A compressor on the SWQP. FID Feb 2026; winter 2028. CapEx is GARY's pro-rata split of the published $260m across 3A's three legs by capacity.

Name: ECGG_3A_MSP
Note: APA ECGG Stage 3A compressor on the MSP mainline. Same $260m pro-rata split.

Name: ECGG_3A_Culcairn
Note: APA ECGG Stage 3A Young-Culcairn lateral. AEMO notes the 39 TJ/d is shared with southern NSW and Uranquinty so not all reaches the VIC DTS. Same $260m pro-rata split.

Name: MSEP_Conversion
Note: Moomba-Sydney Ethane Pipeline converted to natural gas. NSW approval Oct 2025; commissioned pre-winter 2026. APA: total Moomba-Sydney southbound 565 -> 590 TJ/d. The MSP arc carries the pre-conversion 565 so this project is not double-counted; the 20 TJ/d figure APA also quotes is for delivery to Victoria rather than Sydney.

Name: EGP_Reversal
Note: Jemena EGP reversal stage 1 - bi-directional flow up to 200 TJ/d SOUTH toward Victoria; pre-winter 2026. CapEx not public: GARY's own at the MSEP conversion unit rate ($1.11m/TJ-d).

Name: SWP_Compression
Note: APA rule 80 - greenfield compressors at Irrewillipe and Stonehaven plus Winchelsea modification. Iona injection 570->615 TJ/d. AER approved $213m (+$31m early works) 2026; winter 2029.

Name: SWP_Looping
Note: APA's alternative to SWP_Compression - 88 km of SWP looping plus Winchelsea modification. Same 615 TJ/d but more linepack. APA says compression is ~40% cheaper than partial looping; GARY's CapEx = $213m/0.625.

Name: Bulloo_Interlink
Note: APA ECGG Stage 3B - new SWQP-to-MSP link shortening the north-south corridor by ~240 km. 800 TJ/d N->S. Line pipe purchased; targeted end 2028 subject to FID.

Name: ECGG_VTS_Expansion
Note: APA ECGG Stage 5 - MSP+VTS to 350 TJ/d Young to Wollert; APA calls this an ~84% increase which implies a current corridor near 190 TJ/d. Sized to land GARY's corridor on APA's stated 350 endpoint: 350 less the 218 base less ECGG_3A_Culcairn's 39. Winter 2029; not committed. CapEx not public: GARY's own at the ECGG Stage 3A unit rate ($2.43m/TJ-d).

Name: Viva_Geelong_FSRU
Note: Viva Energy Gas Terminal at Corio Bay. EPBC approval Apr 2026; FID H2 2026; operational winter 2029. 750 TJ/d peak / >120 PJ/yr. AEMO: a Geelong terminal lifts total SWP capacity to ~770 TJ/d. CapEx is GARY's own.

Name: Vopak_Victoria_FSRU
Note: Vopak Victoria Energy Terminal in Port Phillip Bay. FSRU secured Sep 2025; EES in progress; targeting pre-winter 2029. Capacity and CapEx are GARY's own - AEMO states the two Geelong terminals behave similarly for the DTS.

Name: Golden_Beach
Note: GB Energy Golden Beach Energy Storage - production 125 TJ/d late 2028 then supply 300 TJ/d early 2029 rising to 375 TJ/d late 2029; 42 PJ store. FID targeted H2 2026. CapEx is GARY's own.

Name: Outer_Harbor_LNG
Note: AG&P Outer Harbor FSRU at Port Adelaide - 400 mmscfd (~422 TJ/d). ~90 of its ~110 PJ/yr is aimed at Victoria (60 PJ to Iona + 30 PJ to the Port Campbell pipeline) via SEA Gas reverse flow. Commissioning late 2027 for winter 2028. CapEx is GARY's own.

Name: SEA_Gas_Reversal
Note: SEA Gas compression and reverse-flow capacity on the Port Campbell-Adelaide pipeline to move Outer Harbor gas east toward Victoria. Capacity mirrors the forward SEA_Gas arc; CapEx is GARY's own.

Name: Port_Kembla_Terminal
Note: Squadron Energy PKET. Mechanically complete but not operating - contracted FSRU redeployed to Egypt; start no earlier than 2027.

Name: Beetaloo_Dev
Note: Beetaloo development. Note the NGP is only 90 TJ/d so southbound Beetaloo volume is corridor-limited until APA's proposed North East Australia Pipeline exists.
